purpose: Freeze the internal CAD/BIM product architecture, UI model, semantic boundaries, parity requirements and staged implementation roadmap without modifying the frozen ConstructionOS platform architecture.
parity_definition: Equivalent professional workflows, semantics, persistence, interoperability, task completion and performance; never copied source code or private/proprietary implementation details.
change_policy: Feature work may evolve within this freeze. Changes to these architectural invariants require CAD/BIM Product Architecture v2.0 and an explicit Architecture Change Request under the parent ConstructionOS governance process.
project_and_sheets_policy: Project and Sheets implementations may develop in parallel in other repositories/branches and integrate later through the shared ConstructionOS domain/application contracts; they are not dependencies of CAD parity.
notes: The existing COMPAT-CAD-004 partial branch is superseded by this parity program and should not be merged.
ConstructionOS Architecture 1.1 remains FROZEN and is not modified by this product architecture package.
